passages.text: Chief complaint: new headache for two weeks.
History: new right-sided weakness for three days.
Neurologic exam: cranial nerves II through XII intact. Right arm and leg strength 4/5. Sensation intact. Gait mildly unsteady.
Impression: new headache with focal deficit raises concern for an intracranial mass.
Plan: order MRI brain without and with contrast (CPT 70553).
